$comment: Subjects and palettes for `illustrate`, the brand's own drawing style as code (rules and sources in brand/illustration.md). Every subject is drawn by the same functions as the share images (src/assets/scene.ts, ported from agd-playground hoplite-og scene.ts). Palettes are the image themes plus a transparent one; colors resolve from tokens.

globe.$source: agd-playground hoplite-og scene.ts drawGlobe; the Header template's whole globe

dome.$source: agd-playground hoplite-og layoutFor horizon: the globe's dome rising from the foot, with a solid ring and a large node on its pole

cube.$source: agd-playground hoplite-og scene.ts drawCube: the wireframe cube cut into cells with its dotted ghost

node.$source: agd-playground hoplite-og scene.ts drawNode: the cog node, a hexagon with a hexagon cut from its middle (also the website's cog, cl-cog)

loader.$source: agd-playground hoplite-og scene.ts drawLoader: the loading bar with its node

window.$source: agd-playground hoplite-og drawWindow (a picture darkened as the brand's aerials are) framed with the website's corner ticks (.ds-corners) inside the dashed rules (scene.ts drawRules)

transparent.$source: the light theme's lines and nodes on no ground
